panels.scene: June at her kitchen table with envelopes and a letter opener, phone at her ear, one eyebrow raised, the small green kettle on the stove. Top third plain wall.
Sam on a train by a window with dusk outside, phone at his ear, warm and patient.
dialogue: No. Who, which routine, when. That is all.

panels.scene: June sliding a letter into a drawer, smiling with satisfaction, the small green kettle on the stove behind her.
panels.caption: Three fields. Nothing else.
